description: Defensive security audit for a PHP endpoint you own. Fetches the URL through an SSRF guard and reports leaked secrets (.env, .git, logs), reachable phpinfo, verbose error disclosure, end-of-life PHP versions, directory listing and missing security headers. Read-only: GET/HEAD only, no injection or exploitation. Returns findings with severity, evidence and a fix for each.

url.description: Public https URL of the PHP endpoint to audit

name: mojomo_audit_php_endpoint
